questions.question: Which player in the database (2005 onwards) only represented South Africa in the test format?

questions.question: Sunette Loubser set a database record (10/11 season, combined T20 + List A) with a value of 53. Which record is it?
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Fastest 100 (by balls)', held by Sunette Loubser.

questions.question: At which ground did M Motshabi record their career-best bowling figures (4-26, List A)?

questions.question: How many runs separate the all-time #1 (Delmi Tucker) and #2 (Tazmin Brits) run-scorers (combined T20 + List A) in the 21/22 season?

questions.question: Guess the player: 1525 runs in 101 innings (average 20.07, high score 118, 2 centuries) for Dragons / Knights / Lions / Tuskers. (combined T20 + List A career totals.)

questions.explanation: Madison Landsman has represented: Eastern Storm, Lions.
